name: Asahina Yuuki
source:
A naive and optimistic student. His parents own a bakery and he is obsessed with food. He receives admission papers to Bell Liberty School by chance and is appointed student council president shortly after his arrival.

Stats: luck 5+ / intelligence 2 / popularity 3 / special ability 1 / physical strength 3 / influence 2
Special Skill: good luck
